description:
You are a regulatory compliance analyst at a financial services firm. An internal audit has identified that the Nuxeo document management system contains documents that do not meet the firm's metadata compliance standards. A reference document titled 'Document Metadata Compliance Standards' has been placed in the Projects workspace and outlines the specific metadata requirements that must be met for each document category.

Your task is to:
1. Review the compliance standards document to understand the requirements
2. Audit all documents in the Projects and Templates workspaces against these standards
3. Remediate any non-compliant documents by updating their metadata to meet the stated requirements
4. Tag each remediated document with 'compliance-reviewed'
5. Add a compliance review comment to each remediated document briefly describing what was corrected
6. Create a collection called 'Q4 2025 Compliance Audit' and add all remediated documents to it
7. Documents with expired dates that have passed must have their lifecycle state updated appropriately

Login credentials: Administrator / Administrator
